bibliography.title: Plug-and-Play Compositionality for Boosting Continual Learning with Foundation Models

sections.title: I Use of Large Language Models

abstract_sentences.text: Vision learners often struggle with catastrophic forgetting due to their reliance on class recognition by comparison, rather than understanding classes as compositions of representative concepts.

evidence.anchor: Vision learners often struggle with catastrophic forgetting

abstract_sentences.text: This limitation is prevalent even in state-of-the-art continual learners with foundation models and worsens when current tasks contain few classes.

evidence.anchor: worsens when current tasks contain few classes

abstract_sentences.text: Inspired by the recent success of concept-level understanding in mitigating forgetting, we design a universal framework CompSLOT to guide concept learning across diverse continual learners.

evidence.anchor: we design a universal framework CompSLOT

abstract_sentences.text: Leveraging the progress of object-centric learning in parsing semantically meaningful slots from images, we tackle the challenge of learning slot extraction from ImageNet-pretrained vision transformers by analyzing meaningful concept properties.

evidence.anchor: learning slot extraction from ImageNet-pretrained vision transformers

abstract_sentences.text: We further introduce a primitive selection and aggregation mechanism to harness concept-level image understanding.

evidence.anchor: primitive selection and aggregation mechanism

abstract_sentences.text: Additionally, we propose a method-agnostic self-supervision approach to distill sample-wise concept-based similarity information into the classifier, reducing reliance on incorrect or partial concepts for classification.

evidence.anchor: distill sample-wise concept-based similarity information into the classifier

abstract_sentences.text: Experiments show CompSLOT significantly enhances various continual learners and provides a universal concept-level module for the community.

evidence.anchor: Experiments show CompSLOT significantly enhances various continual learners
balance the objectives of overcoming catastrophic forgetting and achieving efficient adaptation
do not fully exploit cross-task potential correlations
Can the compositionality in concept learning truly enhance the CL performances
regularizing the outputs of learners with sample-wise similarity based on concepts
The contributions of this work are summarized as follows
The community has mainly developed three families of approaches
five types of tests for language compositionality
Our work, instead, leveraging Slot Attention, does not require prior concept-level supervision
We consider T sequential vision classiﬁcation tasks
slots collect soft assignment information from each patch
slot attention and primitive selection modules are globally shared across tasks
Definition 1 (Concept & Disentanglement)
The reconstruction loss Lre is the MSE loss
The similarity to a learnable primitive key Kp measures the slot significance
Theorem 1 (Intra-class consistency)
we design a primitive-logit alignment loss
We summarize the training framework of CompSLOT in Algorithm 1
additional 10% of total training time for FOSTER

final_judgment.single_storyline: CompSLOT uses ViT patch features and globally shared Slot Attention to select class-relevant primitives, then transfers batch-level primitive similarity to CL logits through La; the authors connect this relation to compositional generalization and reduced forgetting (pp. 2, 5–10).
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: The main text keeps the interface diagram, four numbered loss/metric formulas, paired CGQA results, a component table, a mechanism visualization and the two-stage limitation. These are the decision-bearing objects for judging the proposal (pp. 2, 5–10).
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix D–H move proofs, pseudo-code, exact hyperparameters, six slot diagnostics, CFST detail, most benchmark/backbone comparisons, extra ablations and efficiency. This keeps the main narrative short but makes alignment breadth and cross-setting stability appendix-dependent (pp. 19–33).
final_judgment.best_pattern: The most effective sequence is diagram → formulation → paired baseline result → component ablation → mechanism visualization. Figure 1 fixes the interface and Tables 1–2 plus Figure 4 return to outcome, necessity and mechanism (pp. 2, 8–10).
final_judgment.largest_gap: The largest gap is causal attribution from primitive/logit similarity and higher Hn/R to accuracy gains. Representative matrices and paired outcomes support the explanation, yet metric regressions, sampled images and no mediation-style intervention leave the mechanism partly closed (pp. 8–10, 25–31).
final_judgment.transfer_rule: When a plugin is justified by a mechanism, place a paired outcome comparison, a component/capacity control and a direct mechanism observation in the main text, then state the sample and metric scope. This paper demonstrates that compact chain (pp. 8–10).
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: The rule applies when the mechanism is observable and the benchmark contains relevant compositional structure. If concept sharing is unmeasured, visual evidence is representative only, or theorem premises are definitional, describe the mechanism as explanatory evidence rather than a general guarantee (pp. 6, 18, 23–29).
